headline: Türkiye 10-Year Government Bond Yield Rises to Record High of 36.97%
summary: Türkiye's 10-year government bond yield climbed to an all-time high of 36.97% intraday amid persistent inflation concerns and foreign investor selling.
why: Turkish government bond yields reflect sovereign borrowing costs and investor expectations regarding domestic inflation and monetary policy.

impacts.name: Turkey 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Foreign sell-offs and sticky inflation expectations drove 10-year sovereign yields to a record 36.97%.
